originality.rationale: The inspected 2009 symmetric-graph theorem already gives exact optimal balanced barbell weights and their asymptotics, and the 2025 extended-barbell paper gives unequal-clique optimum data; no novelty is assigned to those exact optima. The surviving quantitative contribution is the uniform finite near-optimizer bridge/holding inverse theorem with sharp perturbation exponents over arbitrary stochastic edge assignments. The inspected primary texts and indexed nearest claims do not state or imply that assertion without the new variational argument. Priority is qualified, not independently certified.
